alert.title: Spike in blocked authentication attempts on auth-svc

findings.question: MLTK anomalydetection: is the blocked-auth rate anomalous?
findings.spl: search index=security sourcetype=auth-svc result=blocked | bin _time span=1m | stats count AS event_count by _time, src_ip | anomalydetection event_count action=annotate
findings.summary: MLTK flagged a spike: 4x baseline; 5 blocked attempts from 2 IP(s) (5.5.5.5, 5.5.5.6).

findings.question: Did any login succeed from the attacker IP(s)?
findings.summary: 1 SUCCESSFUL login(s): account(s) alice likely compromised.

findings.question: What did alice do after logging in?
findings.summary: Post-compromise activity by alice: export 1247 customer_records.

recommended_actions: Force password reset + revoke active sessions
verdict.rationale: A successful login followed a brute-force burst from the same source IP(s) (5.5.5.5, 5.5.5.6); account(s) alice are presumed compromised with post-compromise data export.

narrative: Alert 'Spike in blocked authentication attempts on auth-svc' was triaged as CRITICAL (Account takeover via credential stuffing, confidence 90%). A successful login followed a brute-force burst from the same source IP(s) (5.5.5.5, 5.5.5.6); account(s) alice are presumed compromised with post-compromise data export. Recommend immediate containment: Disable account(s): alice. Source IP(s) 5.5.5.5, 5.5.5.6 should be blocked at the edge.
